items.title: Surface /drivers/:id/profile renders real entity-scoped data with no dead end
items.evidence: NOT YET VERIFIED. Surface enumerated from the route manifest on 2026-07-29. To reach PASS this route must be opened in the running app and shown to render real entity-scoped data (TRANSP and USMCA), every rendered field present in the submit payload where it writes, and forward/reverse linkage proven. No claim is made here beyond the route existing. | Route /drivers/:id/profile wired to pages/drivers/DriverProfilePage.tsx. getDriver requires operating_company_id. Profile sections complete (verify-driver-profile-sections-complete.mjs OK; verify-driver-profile-part2-sections-complete.mjs OK). Navigation, assign-truck, and dead-action guards pass. DriverProfilePage.test.tsx + assign-truck test pass. | FAIL 2026-08-29 CC-2/GUARD, live healthz 14daeed. The page itself renders real entity-scoped data correctly on direct/fresh navigation (License & endorsements, Medical card DOT, DOT medical card history, Drug & alcohol program all honestly reflect this driver's real, all-NULL mdata.drivers columns -- confirmed against Neon, matches the '—' placeholders exactly, not a rendering bug). BUT the page's own 'no dead end' requirement is violated: clicking the 'All profiles' link (and, worse, ANY other in-app navigation link -- sidebar Fleet was also tested) from this page updates the browser URL via history.pushState but the DOM never re-renders to the new route -- the OLD DriverProfilePage content stays frozen on screen indefinitely (confirmed stuck 8+ seconds, zero new network requests fired after the click, zero console errors). Reproduced 3x, including once after a hard reload (cmd+shift+r, bypassing cache) to rule out a stale-JS-chunk-across-deploy artifact from the live deploy that happened mid-session (b276443->14daeed) -- ruled out, this reproduces fresh on the CURRENT deploy. Root cause not fully isolated (not an infinite render loop -- main thread responds instantly to injected JS; not a lazy-chunk load failure -- zero network activity follows the click at all) but the defect itself is definitively confirmed and severe: once a user lands on ANY driver's Qualification Profile page, every subsequent in-app link click silently does nothing until a manual browser reload. Routed to Codex (drivers/fleet FE lane owner per standing orders) via docs/audit/GUARD-WORKORDERS.md -- not fixed here (CC-2/GUARD does not own drivers FE per current lane law). | REOPEN 2026-08-30 CC-3, live healthz 5c825309a5: the assigned fix (PR #17600 / b39edb4b56, RouteContentBoundary keyed-by-location Suspense remount) is confirmed a live ancestor of the current deploy and its own static guard passes, but the freeze reproduces IDENTICALLY on current live -- 3x fresh repro, confirmed stuck 20+ seconds (not just 8), confirmed NOT a caught render error (no ErrorBoundary/SectionErrorBoundary fallback ever renders, no /admin/client-errors POST fires), confirmed React itself is NOT globally hung (the frozen page's own 'Hide from lists' button still toggled driver.status live in the DOM -- reverted immediately, no lasting side effect on the real driver row), confirmed zero uses of useSuspenseQuery exist anywhere in the frontend (ruling out a suspended data-fetch as the mechanism), and confirmed zero new script chunk requests fire on the click (Fleet's lazy chunk is warm, ruling out DRV-F7317's own 'cold lazy chunk' theory as the actual live blocker). Full diagnostic detail + strongest remaining theory (react-router v7's Link dispatch unconditionally wraps in React.startTransition, confirmed in node_modules source, which can hold back ANY new paint -- including the Suspense fallback itself -- indefinitely if something in the transition's render never settles) filed in docs/audit/GUARD-WORKORDERS.md DRV-F7317-ROUTE-BOUNDARY-FIX-DID-NOT-RESOLVE-LIVE. Root cause not conclusively pinned (needs React DevTools Profiler / dev-build access this black-box prod session lacks) -- no guessed fix shipped to the widely-shared Shell/RouteContentBoundary/Sidebar. Status stays FAIL, routed back to Codex with materially richer diagnostics than the original filing. | CLOSED LIVE (CC-3, 2026-08-30, live healthz 84188fabd2): Codex's R2 fix (PR #17984 / a0c0588700, 'DRV-F7317-R2-BROWSERROUTER-TRANSITION-RETAINS-STALE-ROUTE-DOM' -- disables BrowserRouter's default React.startTransition wrapping at the app root, exactly the mechanism named in my prior REOPEN) is confirmed a live ancestor of the current deploy (git merge-base --is-ancestor a0c0588700 84188fabd2). Re-ran the EXACT same live repro that previously froze: hard-reloaded /drivers/435f2b96-91d7-45a9-a6b2-a293acef4857/profile, clicked 'All profiles' -- page correctly navigated to /drivers/profiles and rendered the real Drivers list (159 drivers, 82/159 active, No DQF items: 159). Repeated with a second navigation (sidebar Fleet, the other originally-frozen link) from a fresh profile load -- Fleet correctly rendered (44 units, 30 active). No freeze on either. The 'no dead end' requirement is now genuinely satisfied.
